comparison.objective: Put food and scented toiletries into a bear canister and lock its lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-object packing followed by lid placement and quarter-turn locking.
comparison.success_condition: All four required items inside before the lid is turned to the locked orientation.
comparison.reason: This tests semantic item selection, packing, and lid rotation; it has no precision impact, sacrificial-feature fracture, or fragment containment.
